method: tools/ground_truth/heldout_split.py: per-language floor(30%), remainder by largest share, seeded tie-break and draw

development.ai_corpus: fixtures/ai-corpus is development data: rules were tuned on it. A second corpus from a different generator model, held out, is future work.
development.planted: fixtures/planted is a regression check, never part of a precision claim.

policy: Rule authors must not open findings, labels or excerpts from held-out repositories or ground-truth sources while changing a rule. The precision claim is reported on the held-out split only; a rule tuned on what it is measured on overstates itself.

ai_corpus_heldout.labels: one independent labelling subagent per language, committed before Arbiter was run on the tree; no reconciliation
ai_corpus_heldout.guard: tools/gold/guards.json target ai-corpus-heldout (aggregate: counts and digest only)

_about: Held-out data for the precision claim (plan Phase 1 item 5). Rule authors must not inspect findings on anything listed here, read its labels while writing or tuning a rule, or copy its code into planted fixtures. Only aggregate scores are reported. Each top-level key is one held-out set, so sets added on other branches merge side by side.
